description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kotawila North, Weligama D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820068 (23/0338)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner details, extent of land, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette.
